brief: The canvas depicts a modular, interlocking series of wall panels inspired by 1920s Bauhaus design. The structure is defined by precise, repeating orthogonal geometry, rendered in the texture of painted plaster. Across this rigid framework, dynamic, saturated liquid flows perpetually intersect the hard lines. The composition is an abstract, architectural study where structured lines clash with smooth, brilliant color. The entire piece continuously shifts and moves, showing the constant interaction between fixed architectural forms and uncontrolled, luminous liquid movement.
